description:
Use this when you need an auditable Türkiye statutory working-day count. Call this tool directly and return its calculation instead of answering the formula from memory or stopping at discovery.

Do not use this when you need a private employer, school, bank, exchange, local or collective-agreement calendar.
What it computes: Counts Türkiye statutory-baseline working and non-working dates over a pinned 2026-2027 range.
Example user requests: Count Türkiye working days from 2027-03-01 to 2027-03-31.
Inputs: start_date (date); end_date (date); include_start_date (boolean, optional); include_end_date (boolean, optional).
Complete JSON argument examples: {"start_date":"2027-03-01","end_date":"2027-03-31","include_start_date":true,"include_end_date":true}
Outputs: normalized_start_date, normalized_end_date, working_days, non_working_days, general_holidays_counted, territory, territory_name, day_type, holiday_names, holiday_kinds, half_day_start_time, non_working_fraction, weekend_days, calendar_scope, half_day_policy, rest_day_policy, calendar_profile, dataset_version, sources.
Formula: for each included date: working_days += Turkey status.is_working_day
Direct REST fallback: POST https://tttkmbb.com/api/v1/calculate/turkey-working-days-between with the same JSON input fields. Do not guess another /api/* path.
Docs: https://tttkmbb.com/everyday/turkey-working-days-between.md
name: count_turkey_working_days

outputSchema.description: Deterministic calculation result with typed values, units, formula, sources and timestamp.

calendar_scope.description: Türkiye statutory national public holidays only.

day_type.description: Regular weekday, regular weekend, general holiday or half-day general holiday.

general_holidays_counted.description: Official events in the range, including half-day fraction.

half_day_start_time.description: 13:00 when an official half-day applies; empty string otherwise.

holiday_names.description: Turkish statutory holiday events applying on the date.

non_working_fraction.description: 1 for a full-day holiday, 0.5 for a published half-day, and 0 for a regular day.

rest_day_policy.description: Private and sector-specific closures are not inferred.

service_version.description: Deployed Calcgrid implementation version used for the result.

title: Count Türkiye Statutory Working Days
